qkd_rhead.clock_rule: each entry is delivered at phi - R_child (R = that child view's insertion.json boundary mean); the die model holds them as 35 separate CTS sinks on the stack trunk (frames: R 0 until the views exist)

subslots_canonical_R0.note: canonical orientation R0 = control tile BELOW (S face = control face). Heads below their control tile are placed MX by the die (their S face then faces up). A feasible fit, not a mandate: the head team may move children inside the slot but must keep the die pins and the reach rules below

front.why: under the control tile t span (x 224.8..673.8 in head coords)

subslots_canonical_R0.lanes: 16 x ot_qkh_lane8 (lane_b view 129.6 x 129.6) on a 3 x 6 grid: x = 43.2 + 172.8 c, y = 54 + 151.2 r (18 cells; 16 lanes + ktree + score)

ktree.cell: one free cell + its 43.2 column gap (172.8 >= 151.2)

subslots_canonical_R0.stations: 16 x station <= 32.4 x 32.4, in the 43.2-um column gaps beside their lanes (2 per gap per row)

reach_rules: die pin -> first register <= 500 um: the ti / e inputs land in the front at the S face, s leaves the score; nb leaves on the E face (astk side)

inside the head every register-to-register hop <= 500 um: with the head 1,080 um wide, the native station (one leaf, D = 2 co-located) CANNOT reach both its lane and the E face from the far columns (nb from a column-0 station to the E face ~ 900 um): split the station nb stage into station D 1 + an nb relay leaf D 1 at the E side (latency unchanged), and keep every station within 500 um of the front f_dr pins (else split the front NRS stage the same way)
